messages.subject: raster
parts:
Dear all,

r <- raster(nrows=10, ncols=10); r <- setValues(r, 1:ncell(r))
r1 <- raster(nrows=10, ncols=10);r1 <- setValues(r1, 1:ncell(r))
r2 <- raster(nrows=10, ncols=10);r2 <- setValues(r1, 1:ncell(r))

res=stack(r,r1,r2)

I need to create a raster:

put for example "1" if at least 2 of the three rasters agree on sign otherwise put NA.

Do you have any idea?
thanks,
Bic

messages.author: d42e88b7645d03c8
messages.subject: Re: raster
parts:
Hi Bic,

Please try:



library(raster)
set.seed(123)
r <- raster(nrows=10, ncols=10); r <- setValues(r, round(rnorm(ncell(r)))) 
r1 <- raster(nrows=10, ncols=10);r1 <- setValues(r1, round(rnorm(ncell(r1)))) 
r2 <- raster(nrows=10, ncols=10);r2 <- setValues(r2, round(rnorm(ncell(r2)))) 
r[1:15]
r1[1:15]
r2[1:15]

testIndex <- rep(0, ncell(r))

for (i in 1:ncell(r)) {
  testValue1 <- r[i] == r1[i]
  testValue2 <- r[i] == r2[i]
  testValue3 <- r1[i] == r2[i]
  testValue <- testValue1 + testValue2 + testValue3
  if (testValue >= 2) {
    testIndex[i] <- 1
  } else {
    testIndex[i] <- NA
  }
}

testIndex
res <- raster(nrows=10, ncols=10)
res <- setValues(res, testIndex)
res[1:100]
# end
